decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sharp, multi-sample displacement starting at index 725 with opposing N/E trends and a steep U drop; (2) a brief apparent platform near indices 605–610 following a jump and preceding a U anomaly, possibly indicating a temporary offset or ambiguous return.

regions.observation: Strong multi-axis shift beginning around index 725: N drops sharply from ~8.7 to ~6.9, E rises from ~8.9 to ~9.8 then falls back, U shows a steep drop followed by partial recovery; the abrupt change spans only a few samples and is not clearly reversed within the window.

Apparent platform-like behavior in N/E/U between indices 605–610: N stabilizes near 8.6–8.7, E hovers near 8.3–8.4, U remains near -1.0 to -1.6; this follows a prior large jump (index ~604) and precedes a sharp U drop at index 611, suggesting possible transient offset or measurement artifact rather than smooth motion.
